description_en: Queries the integration status of a specific cloud service
description_zh: 查询指定云服务的集成状态
name: GetIntegratedServiceStatus

parameters.help_en:
The identity of the cloud service that is integrated with Cloud Config. Valid values:

eventbridge: EventBridge
cms: CloudMonitor
bpstudio: Cloud Architect Design Tools (CADT)
parameters.help_zh:
集成的云服务标识。取值：

eventbridge：事件总线。
cms：云监控。
bpstudio：云速搭
parameters.name: service_code

AggregatorDeliveryDataType.description_en:
The type of the event that is integrated across accounts. Valid values:

NonCompliantNotification: non-compliance event
AggregatorDeliveryDataType.description_zh:
跨账号集成的事件类型。支持的事件类型有：
NonCompliantNotification：不合规事件

Data.description_en:
Indicates whether the product has been integrated. Valid values:

true
false
Data.description_zh:
集成的云产品状态。取值：

true：已集成。  
false：未集成

IntegratedTypes.description_en:
The types of the integrated events. Separate multiple event types with commas (,). Valid values:

ConfigurationItemChangeNotification: resource change event
NonCompliantNotification: non-compliance event
IntegratedTypes.description_zh:
集成的事件类型，多个事件类型用半角逗号（,）分隔。支持的事件类型有：

ConfigurationItemChangeNotification：资源变更事件。
NonCompliantNotification：不合规事件
